title: @ohos.file.fs (文件管理)
implementationDecisions: Use app-private local paths and explicit missing-file detection.
writeSync returns bytes; verify complete UTF-8 text and file size instead of equating JavaScript string length with bytes written.
Flush and close the temporary file before renaming it over the reference.
Validate loaded schema, source configuration and finite monotonic samples before display.
Keep existing reference on write failure; do not silently remove invalid files.
verificationBoundary: Documentation review does not prove replacement semantics or durability. Replacement and cold launch are tested on the emulator; injected write, flush and rename failures are host tests. No directory fsync or power-loss test.
